examples.english: To look at the interior of the car.

examples.english: Opinions are divided within the organization, and they can't seem to settle on a policy.

notes:
{内部|ないぶ} refers to the inside of something, either physically or organizationally.

FUNCTIONS:
1. Physical: interior, inside of an object/building
2. Organizational: within a company/group

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内部|ないぶ}⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧: internal structure
- {内部|ないぶ}⟦{告発|こくはつ}→告発：07999_kokuhatsu⟧: whistleblowing
- {内部|ないぶ}⟦{監査|かんさ}→監査：05972_kansa⟧: internal audit
- {内部|ないぶ}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: internal/insider information
- {内部|ないぶ}⟦{犯行|はんこう}→犯行：13472_hankou⟧: inside job

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {内部|ないぶ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from within
- {内部|ないぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: inside, within
- {内部|ないぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: internal (modifying)

OPPOSITE: ⟦{外部|がいぶ}→外部：00052_gaibu⟧ (exterior, external, outside)
